Method of Attack: Hardcoded credentials vulnerability allowing remote, unauthenticated attackers to log into vulnerable servers via a hardcoded password for the disabledsystemuser account
The hardcoded password allows access to all non-restricted pages within Confluence by default
Attack Vector: Installation of Questions for Confluence app versions 2.7.34, 2.7.35, and 3.0.2 which creates a user account with a hardcoded password
The disabledsystemuser account with hardcoded password added to confluence-users group
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of user account disabledsystemuser with username disabledsystemuser and email dontdeletethisuser@email.com
Authentication logs showing last authentication time for disabledsystemuser
